prompt: Which statements about JSON struct tags and streaming are true?
explanation: Struct tags cannot make unexported fields visible to encoding/json; the other statements are correct.

options.text: json:"-" excludes a field from marshaling entirely
json:"name,omitempty" omits the field when it holds its zero value
json.Marshal can serialize unexported fields if tagged
json.Decoder can read incrementally from an io.Reader such as an HTTP body
